roles.name: Director
requirements: Must demonstrate a strong understanding of Strategic Transports Alliance (STA), its structure, rules, policies and operating procedures.
Must demonstrate strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills.
Must be capable of managing staff and resolving internal issues professionally.
Must maintain a professional standard when representing STA and any associated groups.
Must be trustworthy with confidential or sensitive management information
Must be capable of working independently and making appropriate decisions without constant supervision.
Must communicate and work effectively with other members of Senior Management.
Must demonstrate a high level of activity and commitment to STA.
Must have a good standing within STA and the wider community
Must disclose any positions, responsibilities or conflicts of interest within other organisations where they could affect their STA responsibilities.
Appointment to Director or Senior Management is subject to approval from the Founder/Owner or authorised Senior Management.
responsibilities: Oversee the operation and development of STA.
Provide leadership and guidance to Managers and departments.
Ensure STA policies, procedures and standards are being followed.
Make decisions concerning the operation, development and future direction of STA.
Review serious staff, disciplinary or operational matters where escalation is required.
Support Managers when dealing with complex situations.
Ensure departments are operating effectively
Maintain communication between Senior Management and departmental management.
Approve significant departmental changes where required.
Represent STA professionally when communicating with external organisations.
Protect the reputation and interests of STA and its associated groups.
Assist with recruitment or appointment of Managers and other management personnel.
Report significant concerns to the Founder/Owner.

roles.name: Developer
requirements: Must have appropriate knowledge of the systems, platforms or development work used by STA.
Must be capable of troubleshooting technical problems.
Must understand the importance of testing changes before implementation.
Must be able to document technical changes where necessary.
Must communicate effectively with Senior Management and other departments.
Must maintain appropriate security and confidentiality when accessing STA systems.
Manager must be capable of allocating and supervising development work.
Manager must have sufficient technical knowledge to review the work completed by the department.
responsibilities: Maintain and develop STA's technical systems and infrastructure.
Investigate and resolve technical problems.
Develop new systems, tools and features where required.
Maintain existing systems and ensure they remain operational.
Test changes before deployment.
Maintain backups and appropriate technical documentation where applicable.
Manage permissions and technical access where authorised.
Work with other departments to develop systems that support their operations.
Report significant technical problems or security concerns to Senior Management.
Ensure development projects are appropriately planned and managed.
Maintain a record of major changes where necessary.

roles.name: Human Resources
requirements: Must have a strong understanding of STA's staff rules, policies and procedures.
Must demonstrate maturity, fairness and impartiality.
Must be capable of handling confidential information appropriately.
Must have strong communication and conflict-resolution skills.
Must be capable of investigating staff concerns and complaints professionally.
Must avoid favouritism when dealing with staff matters.
Manager must be capable of supervising recruitment, disciplinary and staff-management processes.
Manager must know when matters should be escalated to Senior Management.
responsibilities: Oversee staff recruitment and onboarding.
Manage staff records and relevant internal information.
Process promotions, transfers, resignations and removals where authorised.
Manage staff Leave of Absence processes.
Investigate staff complaints and internal concerns.
Handle disciplinary matters within the authority delegated to Human Resources.
Escalate serious disciplinary matters to Senior Management.
Ensure staff are treated fairly and consistently.
Monitor staff activity where required.
Support Managers with staff-related matters.
Maintain appropriate confidentiality.
Ensure staff understand relevant STA policies and expectations.
Assist with management recruitment and appointments where required.

roles.name: Media Staff
requirements: Must have a good understanding of STA's branding and public image.
Must demonstrate good written communication.
Must understand appropriate standards for public communications.
Must be capable of planning and coordinating media coverage.
Must be able to work with other departments when promoting events or announcements.
Manager must be capable of reviewing and approving media before publication where required.
Manager must ensure published content appropriately represents STA.
responsibilities: Manage STA's social media and public-facing media presence.
Produce and coordinate posts, announcements and promotional material.
Provide media coverage for STA activities and events.
Coordinate photography, videography and other media where applicable.
Work with the Graphic Design Team when graphical material is required.
Maintain consistent STA branding across published content.
Ensure public information is accurate before publication.
Maintain appropriate standards when responding publicly on behalf of STA.
Plan media campaigns for major events or announcements.
Maintain an appropriate media schedule where required.
Report reputational concerns to Senior Management.

roles.name: Graphics Designer
requirements: Must demonstrate appropriate graphic-design skills.
Must understand STA's branding and visual standards.
Must be capable of producing graphics suitable for public use.
Must be able to work from briefs supplied by other departments.
Must be capable of meeting reasonable deadlines.
Manager must be capable of reviewing designs and maintaining consistent quality.
Manager must ensure STA branding is used correctly.
responsibilities: Produce graphics required by STA.
Create event graphics, advertisements, announcements and promotional material.
Maintain STA's visual identity.
Maintain templates and reusable graphical resources.
Work with the Media and Event Teams on promotional requirements.
Review graphics before publication where required.
Ensure logos, branding and other assets are used correctly.
Maintain organised storage of design assets and source files where appropriate.
Update existing designs when STA branding changes.
Ensure completed designs meet the requirements of the requesting department.

roles.name: Event Staff
requirements: Must have a strong understanding of STA's event policies and procedures.
Must understand TruckersMP event systems and general convoy procedures.
Must be capable of reviewing event invitations against STA requirements.
Must demonstrate good organisational and communication skills.
Must understand STA's attendance, slot-booking and event-information requirements.
Manager must be capable of making or recommending event attendance decisions.
Manager must coordinate effectively with Convoy Control, Media and Senior Management.
responsibilities: Process event invitations received by STA.
Check invitations against STA's event requirements and policies.
Confirm whether STA will attend invited events.
Manage slot bookings where required.
Maintain STA's event calendar and attendance records.
Communicate event information to relevant staff and drivers.
Ensure required event information is available before attendance.
Organise STA-hosted events and convoys.
Coordinate with Convoy Control where CC services are required.
Coordinate with Media and Graphic Design for event promotion.
Communicate changes, cancellations or important event information.
Escalate unusual or significant event issues to Senior Management.

roles.name: Convoy Control
requirements: Must have strong knowledge of convoy procedures and Convoy Control operations.
Must understand relevant TruckersMP rules.
Must demonstrate good driving ability and situational awareness.
Must be capable of communicating instructions clearly.
Must understand the different Convoy Control positions and their responsibilities.
Must remain calm and professional during incidents or unexpected situations.
Manager must be capable of planning complete Convoy Control operations.
Manager must be capable of allocating staff and positions appropriately.
Manager must coordinate with event organisers and relevant STA/associated-group management.
responsibilities: Plan Convoy Control operations for events where services are being provided.
Produce CC plans, position allocations and relevant operational information.
Assign appropriate personnel to CC positions.
Conduct or organise staff briefings.
Coordinate Lead, Tail and other CC positions where required.
Ensure staff understand the route and their assigned responsibilities.
Monitor convoy operations during events.
Respond to incidents or changes during the convoy.
Maintain professional communication with event organisers.
Ensure CC personnel appropriately represent STA and associated groups.
Review significant incidents following events.
Report serious operational or staff concerns to Senior Management.
Coordinate with the Event Team where required.

roles.name: Support
requirements: Must have strong knowledge of STA's rules, policies and general operations.
Must demonstrate good written communication.
Must be capable of communicating professionally with members and external users.
Must understand when an issue should be escalated.
Must maintain confidentiality where support tickets contain private information.
Must remain impartial when handling complaints or disputes.
Manager must be capable of supervising the support system and reviewing escalated cases.
Manager must ensure support decisions are consistent with STA policy.
responsibilities: Manage STA support tickets and general enquiries.
Provide accurate information regarding STA policies and procedures.
Direct enquiries to the appropriate department where required.
Handle complaints within the Support Team's authority.
Escalate staff, disciplinary or management complaints to Human Resources or Senior Management.
Maintain professional communication throughout support cases.
Ensure tickets are handled within appropriate timescales.
Maintain appropriate records of support cases.
Identify recurring problems and report them to the relevant department.
Assist users with navigating STA's systems and processes.
Ensure Support Team responses remain consistent and accurate.

roles.name: Divisional Manager
requirements: Must have a strong understanding of STA's driver structure and divisional system.
Must demonstrate good leadership and organisational skills.
Must maintain appropriate activity within STA.
Must understand the requirements and purpose of the division they manage.
Must communicate effectively with drivers and Senior Management.
Must be capable of resolving routine divisional issues.
Must maintain professional standards when representing their division.
Must understand when matters need to be referred to another department or Senior Management.
responsibilities: Manage the day-to-day operation of their assigned division.
Act as the main management contact for drivers within the division.
Encourage activity and participation within the division.
Ensure drivers follow STA rules and divisional requirements.
Organise division-specific activities where appropriate.
Monitor the general operation and development of the division.
Raise concerns regarding drivers through the appropriate management process.
Work with the Event Team to encourage participation in events.
Communicate relevant information and changes to divisional members.
Provide updates to Senior Management where required.
Recommend improvements to their division.
Ensure the division continues to operate in accordance with STA's overall objectives.
